full_vs_development_prior.interpretation: FULL_STRUCTURAL improves the naive prior on this holdout; match-bootstrap intervals exclude zero.

full_vs_external_market_close.interpretation: Point estimates favor external close; intervals cross zero, so neither superiority claim is established.

incremental_full_vs_elo_only.interpretation: No reliable incremental improvement beyond Elo.

paired_uncertainty_summary.limitation: Match-level diagnostic only; one league-season holdout and schedule dependence prevent operational promotion.

elo_plus_form_vs_market.interpretation: Negative intervals exclude zero: the external closing benchmark has lower loss than the best structural variant on Norway 2025.

full_vs_elo_only.interpretation: No reliable incremental gain from the full structural bundle.

paired_uncertainty_summary.limitation: Paired match bootstrap remains diagnostic; closing is an external near-kickoff benchmark, not a GoldBet TRUE OPEN signal or executable historical strategy.

draw_diagnostic.interpretation: Draw probability level is broadly calibrated for Elo variants; zero argmax selections do not imply zero draw probability. Accuracy must not substitute probabilistic calibration.

league_drift.interpretation: The 2025 Sweden market benchmark is materially harder/less predictable than Norway; no causal league explanation is claimed.

prior_612_match_claim.reason: All published point estimates replicate from clean source, but selection uses later CLOSE information and every bootstrap ROI interval includes zero.

goldbet_t30_exact_outcome_pilot.interpretation: Descriptive pilot only. Fixture n=2 above thresholds and correlated market rows make ROI/hit-rate unstable; no rule promoted.

goldbet_true_open_exact_outcome_calibrat.interpretation: Observed-current has marginally better point estimates, but fixture-clustered intervals cross zero in aggregate and in every market. No superiority, threshold or operational rule is established.

goldbet_fixture_level_mms_2026.interpretation: No market-threshold cell supports promotion. Observed-current timing is heterogeneous and not CLOSE; independent replication remains mandatory.

goldbet_mms_stability_2026.interpretation: Material reversals indicate timing/composition and temporal drift. They do not promote early/late or far/near sub-rules; independent temporal replication is required.

goldbet_1x2_drift_decomposition_2026.interpretation: The 1X2 PP1 timing drift survives side and price-band standardization. This is evidence of instability/confounding, not a causal timing advantage or an operational subgroup.

ablation_plan.promotion_rule: No module becomes an autonomous edge without replicable OOS improvement.

next_increment.priority: Explain the residual 1X2 timing drift by competition and ordered time block, while keeping side/price standardization fixed and avoiding subgroup tuning.
next_increment.structural_lane: Keep all multi-season OOS structural blocks frozen.
next_increment.market_lane: Persist genuine T-30/last-pre-kickoff GoldBet snapshots; heterogeneous observed-current timing remains unsuitable as CLOSE.
next_increment.mms_lane: All pooled and timing-subgroup thresholds remain rejected pending an independent temporal block.

promoted_rules: RESEARCH_ONLY: retain ELO_ONLY as the structural historical benchmark for subsequent leagues; it improves naive priors on Sweden, Norway and the pooled frozen holdout. This is not an operational betting rule.
rejected_rules: Sweden v1: reject the claim that prior-five form, goal balance, venue PPG and opponent-quality features add a reliable OOS gain beyond Elo; paired 2025 intervals include zero.
Cross-league Sweden+Norway v1: reject promotion of the full prior-five form/goal-balance/venue/opponent-quality bundle beyond Elo; neither 2025 holdout provides a reliable paired improvement.
Norway v1: reject any claim that a structure-only 1X2 model matches the information in the external closing market; the closing benchmark has significantly lower Brier and log-loss.
Pooled Sweden+Norway: reject promotion of prior-five form as an incremental module beyond Elo; paired intervals include zero.
Pooled Sweden+Norway: reject the full structural bundle as an improvement over Elo; point estimates are worse and paired intervals include zero.

Primeira Liga+Eredivisie v1.47/v1.77: reject promotion of every 1X2 and O/U 2.5 threshold; all pooled early-ROI intervals include zero, results are league-heterogeneous, and selection is CLOSE-conditioned.
Netherlands v1: reject prior-five form and the full structural bundle as incremental improvements beyond Elo; both have worse point estimates and paired intervals include zero.
GoldBet T-30 pilot v1: reject promotion of all 1/2/3pp shortening thresholds; signals occur on only two fixtures and rows are correlated across 1X2 and total-goal lines.

GoldBet exact-outcome calibration v1: reject the claim that the heterogeneous pre-kickoff observed-current snapshot reliably improves TRUE OPEN; all fixture-clustered paired Brier/log-loss intervals cross zero.
GoldBet fixture-level MMS v1: reject promotion of de-vig shortening thresholds >=1/2/3pp for FT 1X2, O/U 2.5 and BTTS; every 10,000-draw ROI interval includes zero.
GoldBet fixture-level MMS v1: reject the legacy absolute price-drop >=0.20 rule across 1X2, O/U 2.5 and BTTS; all ROI intervals include zero and O/U/BTTS point ROI is negative.
GoldBet MMS stability v1: reject pooled interpretation of 1X2 movement ROI across heterogeneous lead times; <360 and >=360 minute samples differ materially.

GoldBet 1X2 drift decomposition v1: reject the claim that the <360 versus >=360 minute ROI reversal is explained solely by selected side or observed-current price mix; the standardized near-minus-far interval remains entirely negative.
historical_method_changes: Structural fixture eligibility separated from market-price eligibility.
Latest four completed Allsvenskan seasons frozen as 2022-2025.
Cross-division playoffs excluded from regular-season comparability.
2025 frozen as temporal holdout.
External average closing odds accepted only as de-vigged market benchmark.
Paired match-bootstrap uncertainty added as a diagnostic after the frozen one-shot holdout evaluation; model and hyperparameters were not changed.
Team identity canonicalization is now an eligibility gate: league-season team counts and schedules must be reconciled before any OOS metric is accepted.
Superseded OOS reports caused by identity errors must remain explicitly quarantined rather than silently overwritten.
Classwise probability calibration is mandatory when an outcome is never the argmax; top-pick accuracy alone cannot diagnose probabilistic failure.
League-specific drift must be reported before pooling closing-market benchmarks.
Expensive historical evidence generation is separated from fast race-safe publication to avoid interference from operational feed commits.
Archived aggregate evidence is recoverable and hashable, but cannot be labelled row-level reproducible until the original match inputs and raw timestamps are recovered.

A complete target subset may be recovered from a truncated container only when expected row counts, selection sets, missingness and a canonical subset hash are recorded; the corrupt parent remains quarantined.
Clean immutable source CSV snapshots with SHA-256 supersede truncated intermediates; both 1X2 and O/U are now reproducible from source rows.

European season-file acquisition may replace a missing country-level consolidated CSV only when each immutable league-season file is separately hashed, row-count gated and normalized with unchanged provenance labels.
Fields named home_score/away_score/match_score in the Diretta index are identity-match confidence values, not final scores; outcome semantics require a separately documented result source.
A pre-kickoff current price is not a CLOSE unless it is proven to be the last valid same-book observation before kickoff; timing alone is insufficient.
Final outcomes may be joined through exact Flashscore event IDs only after pre-match price features are frozen; T-30 checkpoint quality and distance must remain explicit.
Outcome resolution scales only through exact Flashscore event IDs; feeds lacking both regular-half score sections remain unresolved and excluded rather than inferred.
MMS threshold tests use at most one pre-specified candidate per fixture and market; correlated totals lines and opposing selections may not be counted as independent signals.
MMS reports must segment lead time and ordered temporal blocks before pooling; a significant subgroup reversal is classified as drift/confounding until independently replicated.
Material MMS lead-time drift must be standardized at minimum by selection side and price band; persistence after standardization is recorded as instability/confounding, never as a timing rule.
rule_decisions.note: Elo is promoted only as a research baseline. No betting threshold, GoldBet signal or operational Radar rule is promoted.
